producedBy: An independent reference implementation in Python (statistics.pstdev for Bollinger's sigma), written from the study definitions in CLIENT.md 11.6 rather than from packages/web/src/chart/studies/trend.ts. A golden generated by the module it judges can only catch tomorrow's regression; this one can catch today's bug.
note: CLIENT.md 11.6 names yahoo-chart-AAPL-max-1d.json as the study-golden capture. That capture is QUARTERLY (docs/TESTING.md L748), so a 20-period study computed on it would be a five-year average labelled a one-month one. This golden uses yahoo-chart-events.json instead: 1,255 genuinely DAILY bars of the same instrument. Stated deviation, not a quiet substitution.
